name: Measurement
summary: A full set of body measurements taken by hand, plus notes on posture and how you like clothes to sit.
body: We take upward of 20 individual measurements depending on the garment — not just chest and waist, but shoulder slope, arm swing, posture and stance, which off-the-rack sizing never accounts for.
Your measurements and fit notes are saved to your personal pattern file, so future orders can skip straight to cutting without a repeat session.
For remote clients, we provide a guided self-measurement kit and review your numbers together on a video call before cutting begins.

seo.title: Measurement — Our Process
seo.description: How Lipek Fashion takes and records your measurements for a pattern that's kept on file for every future order.
